description: Pregnancy Due Date & Milestones — Offline pregnancy dating calculator following ACOG conventions: due date, gestational age (weeks+days), trimester, term status, days to go, percent complete, term windows and dated milestones (NIPT, NT scan, anatomy scan, glucose screen, Tdap, Rh immune globulin, RSV vaccine window, GBS screen) with past/now/upcoming status. Dates from one of: lmp= (with optional cycle_length=), conception=, transfer= (IVF, embryo_day=3|5|6), edd=, or ultrasound_date= + ga= (e.g. 8w3d; also compares to lmp= using ACOG redating thresholds). Optional as_of=. All dates YYYY-MM-DD. Informational, not medical advice. Price: $0.002 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: health_pregnancy_dates
